item.title: WhatsApp underlines correct words? Fix the spell-check language.
item.description: A tested WebView2 workaround for WhatsApp Desktop when the spell checker ignores your writing language. Keep Windows in English.

item.title: Change the spell-check dictionary in ChatGPT / Codex Desktop.
item.description: Add your writing language to the desktop app’s Preferences file when correct words are flagged as English spelling errors.
